Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full window is used because MUSIC/quiet_discovery is sparse by design: the first 2 s of this window measure -91 dB mean (near-silence), so a 2 s slice would show no measurable cut even though the compressor is engaged.
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
